verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a business-services SaaS like a registered agent provider, since such vendors can offer partner APIs and client libraries, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no SDK or API. The only first-party probe hit a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt, and the lone community comment concerns SEO visibility, not developer tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
